routes._comment: Read-only files API for RPA (Michael Kunisaki's team). Auth is API-key-only (X-API-Key header), enforced inside the Function. Must be anonymous at the SWA layer so RPA isn't redirected to Entra SSO.

Uploader auto-trigger + manual-trigger button: called by the signed-in user's browser. POST enqueues an AA WLM work item when all 5 slots are populated (with optional force: true to bypass the marker-blob idempotency check). GET returns a lightweight status probe {allSlotsComplete, missing, encDataExists} used by the manual-trigger button's confirmation dialog. Requires Entra SSO (unlike /api/files/* which is API-key gated for RPA).

Snapshot API (/api/snapshot/index + /api/snapshot/{YYYY-MM}). Backed by the container-produced blobs in stafnfhauploads/snapshots/. User-facing dashboard data — Entra SSO only, no API key (matches ai-analysis, not files-list).

On-demand write-back path for the baked Portfolio Risk Factor bullets (PR B). Called by the ExecutiveSummary 'Regenerate' button; the Function reads X-MS-CLIENT-PRINCIPAL to stamp regenerated_by. Entra SSO only, same gate as /api/snapshot/*.

Scenario evaluator + manual cache-purge endpoint (PR-A of Scenario Builder — docs/scenario-builder-design.md §3.2 + §9 Q11). Entra SSO only, same gate as /api/snapshot/*. Admin gate on /api/evaluate/purge is enforced inside the Function via ADMIN_ALLOWLIST.
